summary.text: Ray Canterbury, listed by Ballotpedia as Denny Canterbury Jr., is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 47 who is seeking re-election against Democrat Sarah Morris in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the House from 2000 to 2016 and returned in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Ray Canterbury was born in Charleston, West Virginia, and lives in Ronceverte, West Virginia.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Chicago in 1991 and an M.B.A. from West Virginia University in 1996, and his career experience includes working with an Internet startup company.
Canterbury represented West Virginia House of Delegates District 42 from 2000 to 2016, and in the 2015 session chaired the Pensions and Retirement Committee.
He returned to the House in 2024 representing District 47, succeeding Todd Longanacre.
